records.name: Andhra University (Geology)
records.description: Andhra University in Visakhapatnam is one of India's oldest universities, and its Department of Geology is highly regarded for research in economic geology, geochemistry, and marine geology. The university offers B.Sc., M.Sc., M.Phil., and Ph.D. programs in geology with faculty recognized for their contributions to Precambrian geology of peninsular India. Its coastal location makes it particularly strong in marine geology research.

records.name: BHU (Geology)
records.description: BHU's Department of Geology within the Faculty of Science is among the top geology departments in Indian universities, known for research in sedimentary geology, paleontology, and geochemistry. It offers M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs with a strong emphasis on fieldwork in the Vindhyan and Gondwana geological sequences of central India. The department has produced eminent geologists who have served in GSI, ONGC, and academia.

records.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) Academy
records.description: ONGC Academy in Dehradun (formerly IDT – Institute of Drilling Technology) is the training arm of Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC), providing technical and managerial training to ONGC employees and energy sector professionals. It offers programs in petroleum engineering, drilling technology, geosciences, and HSE (Health, Safety, Environment). The Academy also collaborates with international oil and gas institutions for advanced training programs.

records.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD)
records.description: India Meteorological Department (IMD) is the national meteorological service of India under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, responsible for weather forecasting, seismology, and climate monitoring across the country. IMD offers specialized training programs through its Meteorological Training Institute for weather professionals and conducts research in tropical meteorology, monsoon dynamics, and climate change. It operates a wide network of observatories and provides critical weather services for aviation, agriculture, and disaster management.

records.name: IIT Delhi (Atmospheric Sciences)
records.description: IIT Delhi's Centre for Atmospheric Sciences (CAS) is a leading research unit offering M.Tech. and Ph.D. programs in atmospheric sciences, climate modeling, and air quality research. The centre has state-of-the-art computational and observational facilities and strong collaborations with IMD, IITM Pune, and international climate research centers. Research areas include monsoon dynamics, aerosol-cloud interactions, and urban heat islands.

records.name: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)
records.description: Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM) Pune is a premier research institute under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, dedicated to research in tropical meteorology, monsoon prediction, climate variability, and earth system science. It operates India's Earth System Models and contributes to IPCC assessment reports, playing a crucial role in India's climate change research and policy. IITM offers Ph.D. programs and collaborative research fellowships with international institutions.

records.name: Cochin University of Science and Technology
records.description: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) is a premier technical university in Kerala, particularly renowned for its programs in marine sciences, ship technology, and atmospheric sciences. Its School of Marine Sciences offers M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs with strong research in fisheries biology, physical oceanography, and coastal management. CUSAT's location on the Kerala coast provides unique advantages for marine research and industry interaction.

records.name: National Institute of Oceanography (NIO)
records.description: National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) Goa is a premier ocean research institute under CSIR, known for world-class research in physical, chemical, biological, and geological oceanography. NIO operates research vessels for deep-sea expeditions and is involved in India's seabed mineral exploration programs. It offers Ph.D. programs through AcSIR and hosts national and international research fellowships in marine science.

records.name: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)
records.description: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) Hyderabad is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, responsible for providing ocean information and advisory services to society, industry, and government. It operates the Indian Ocean Tsunami Warning System and provides operational ocean state forecasts, potential fishing zone advisories, and storm surge warnings. INCOIS offers research programs in operational oceanography and ocean data management.

records.name: National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)
records.description: National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT) Chennai is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, focusing on the development of reliable indigenous technology for harnessing ocean resources and observations. It has developed deep-sea mining systems, ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC) plants, and real-time ocean monitoring buoy networks. NIOT offers research internships and collaborative Ph.D. programs in ocean engineering and marine technology.
